def test_iforest_warm_start():
    """Test that the warm_start parameter of IsolationForest works."""
    X = iris.data
    n_estimators = 5
    n_estimators_2 = 15

    # warm_start=False: a second fit does not grow the ensemble
    clf = IsolationForest(n_estimators=n_estimators, warm_start=False,
                          random_state=rng)
    clf.fit(X)
    assert_equal(len(clf.estimators_), n_estimators)

    clf.set_params(n_estimators=n_estimators_2)
    clf.fit(X)
    assert_equal(len(clf.estimators_), n_estimators_2)

    # warm_start=True: fitting again adds new trees to the existing ensemble
    clf = IsolationForest(n_estimators=n_estimators, warm_start=True,
                          random_state=rng)
    clf.fit(X)
    assert_equal(len(clf.estimators_), n_estimators)
    first_estimators = clf.estimators_[:n_estimators]

    clf.set_params(n_estimators=n_estimators_2)
    clf.fit(X)
    assert_equal(len(clf.estimators_), n_estimators_2)
    # previously fitted trees are reused, not refitted
    for est_old, est_new in zip(first_estimators, clf.estimators_):
        assert est_old is est_new

    # the parameter is exposed and defaults to False
    assert IsolationForest().warm_start is False
